title: Package 163 (Job 1419488) 100-Iteration Convergence Diagnosis and Continuation Strategy
finding: Package 163 (Job 1419488) terminated at outer iteration 100 due to max_outer cap without coupled convergence, but exhibited monotonic linear contraction (rho ~ 0.967) with zero limit cycling, strict KKT residual convergence (dual error 2.18e-9, free error 4.33e-10), and steady active-set pruning (3652 -> 3263 across outers 80-100).

diagnosis_summary.reason: Iteration cap reached while in healthy asymptotic linear convergence regime

proposed_continuation_strategy.primary_recommendation: Extend outer iteration limit from 100 to 200 in C5ForwardContinuationController while maintaining unchanged physical tolerances, frozen UEL, and non-accumulating history formulation.
proposed_continuation_strategy.scientific_justification: The solver exhibits strictly monotonic error decay without active-set oscillation. With rho ~ 0.967, coupled tolerances are projected to be reached at ~150-180 iterations. Walltime for 100 iterations was 53m50s, so 200 iterations will complete in ~1.8 hours, well within cluster resource limits.
proposed_continuation_strategy.alternative_acceleration: Optional Aitken dynamic relaxation or Anderson acceleration on phase field increments to reduce effective spectral radius rho below 0.85 without altering stationary solution.
